objections.reason: 'perfection' is the established rendering of pāramitā (T159); sampad needs a distinct word, and English children's value is 'excellence'.
'trois mondes' is already T229 ('jig rten gsum, three worlds); khams gsum is the three realms, and English keeps them apart.
Same collision with T229 'trois mondes'; 'royaumes' follows 'realms' (cf. T317 children 'royaume').
'mauvaise action' is already pāpa (T011, T025, T330); T361 (same mi dge) already uses 'action qui n'est pas bonne'. Keep the two aligned.
'idée' names a thing, not the activity of conceptualizing (rnam rtog); a phrase keeps the process meaning.
Missing article; must parallel T158 'perfection de la générosité'.
'sagesse parfaite' inverts the title structure and breaks parallel with T158 'perfection du don'.

objections.proposed: le fait de ne pas durer
objections.reason: 'qui ne dure pas' is an adjective phrase (identical to T149 anitya); anityatā is a noun.
Same ratna is 'joyau' in T325 and 'Trois Joyaux' in T204; 'bijou' breaks the link.
Capital P as in academic field and T045/T087 'Protecteur' epithet.
Same epithet as T052, rendered 'Celui qui est bien allé'; 'Bien-Allé' is inconsistent and hard for children.
'receveur' is awkward (tax collector, ticket seller) in French; 'destinataire' is the natural term.
'Trichiliocosme' is the established French Buddhist term; 'trois mille mondes' misstates the thousandfold-cubed structure.
Same sense label as T349 ('chargé de méfaits'); 'auteur' changes meaning to perpetrator, whereas sdig ldan means possessing misdeeds.
Gender inconsistent: T474 uses 'la bodhicitta' (the established French usage) but this entry has 'du bodhicitta'.
